mapper.select: select from cost_boq_compare c left join cost_boq_item li on li.id = c.left_item_id and li.del_flag = '0' left join cost_boq_item ri on ri.id = c.right_item_id and ri.del_flag = '0' where c.del_flag = '0' and c.project_id = #{projectId} and c.left_batch_id = #{leftBatchId} and c.right_batch_id = #{rightBatchId} order by c.id asc

select from cost_boq_compare c left join cost_boq_item li on li.id = c.left_item_id and li.del_flag = '0' left join cost_boq_item ri on ri.id = c.right_item_id and ri.del_flag = '0' where c.id = #{id} and c.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select count(1) total_count, coalesce(sum(case when match_type in ('EXACT','HIGH_SIMILARITY','LOW_SIMILARITY','MANUAL') then 1 else 0 end), 0) matched_count, coalesce(sum(case when match_type = 'EXACT' then 1 else 0 end), 0) exact_count, coalesce(sum(case when match_type = 'HIGH_SIMILARITY' then 1 else 0 end), 0) high_similarity_count, coalesce(sum(case when match_type = 'LOW_SIMILARITY' then 1 else 0 end), 0) low_similarity_count, coalesce(sum(case when match_type = 'ONLY_LEFT' then 1 else 0 end), 0) only_left_count, coalesce(sum(case when match_type = 'ONLY_RIGHT' then 1 else 0 end), 0) only_right_count, coalesce(sum(case when match_type = 'MANUAL' then 1 else 0 end), 0) manual_count, coalesce(avg(case when left_item_id is not null and right_item_id is not null then match_score end), 0) average_match_score from cost_boq_compare where del_flag = '0' and project_id = #{projectId} and left_batch_id = #{leftBatchId} and right_batch_id = #{rightBatchId}
mapper.insert:
insert into cost_boq_compare ( project_id, left_batch_id, right_batch_id, left_item_id, right_item_id, match_type, match_score, quantity_diff, quantity_diff_rate, unit_price_diff, unit_price_diff_rate, total_price_diff, total_price_diff_rate, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) values
(#{r.projectId}, #{r.leftBatchId}, #{r.rightBatchId}, #{r.leftItemId}, #{r.rightItemId}, #{r.matchType}, #{r.matchScore}, #{r.quantityDiff}, #{r.quantityDiffRate}, #{r.unitPriceDiff}, #{r.unitPriceDiffRate}, #{r.totalPriceDiff}, #{r.totalPriceDiffRate}, #{r.createBy}, #{r.createTime}, '0')
mapper.update: update cost_boq_compare set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update cost_boq_compare set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and (left_batch_id = #{batchId} or right_batch_id = #{batchId})
